employer_specifics: Simudyne builds an agent-based simulation platform (Java-based SDK; products branded Discover / Simulate / Reason, plus a public 'Model Garden' and patents) for financial institutions - clients include global banks, regulators and exchanges.
Founded 2016 by Justin Lyon; graduated Barclays Techstars (2017) and Mastercard Start Path (2018); small team (~12 per Getro) including PhDs; HQ 125 Wood Street, London EC2V.

The FDE role was about building and deploying custom Java simulation solutions on client sites end-to-end (requirements to production), integrating large-scale data into simulation and AI frameworks, with 10-20% client travel.
Listing explicitly requires MSc or above in CS/AI, strong Java, working Python, and 1-2 years post-university experience - i.e. a junior/early-career hire.
verify.red_flags: (1) Role appears closed: employer page 404, no roles on Simudyne careers index, and the Techstars copy is a 5-month-old aggregator entry. (3) Agent-based modelling (discrete-event/ABM simulation) is not agentic AI; the scout's keyword match was flagged as risky in triage and the listing confirms it. (4) Pay unstated ("Competitive salary") on a junior permanent role at a ~12-person Series A company - very unlikely to meet the GBP 80k floor.
